milestones.title: Client-safe activity resolution and curated policy
acceptance_criteria: Browser code can resolve the canonical activity and its recommended structures without importing biblioteca.ts or decoraciones.json.
Every recognised activity maps to at least three unique official IDs, none in ESTRUCTURAS_SIN_VISTA_3D, enforced by a test.
Existing event and library-search consumers compile with unchanged imports and synonyms.

milestones.title: Server enforcement and audit for complete proposals
acceptance_criteria: For a recognised activity, a free complete proposal only contains recommended or customer-named structures.
Out-of-policy provider output is corrected deterministically and recorded as a regla:estructuras_por_evento decision.
Unknown activities, individual-piece turns and plan edits keep the current tool schema and proposal handling.

milestones.title: Activity-aware individual-piece menu
acceptance_criteria: For a recognised activity the piece menu shows the recommended structures in mapping order, then «La que tú quieras».
For an unknown activity the menu equals the current PIEZAS_INDIVIDUALES list.
The widget schema and saved-session shape are unchanged.

milestones.title: Integration gate
acceptance_criteria: guiada:test runs the three new regression scripts.
Lint, workspace builds, application type check, guiada:test and the Next.js build results are reported with their real exit status.

tasks.title: Extract client-safe text normalizer and canonical event parser
tasks.objective: The canonical event parser becomes importable from browser code without loading the decoration catalogue, while existing server consumers keep identical behaviour.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Pure functions move behind re-exports; consumers were located by search and need no edits.

complexity.justification: Moving two pure functions behind re-exports is a known localized refactor with no new logic.

scope.justification: Two new small modules plus re-export edits in two existing files, with no consumer edits.

duration.justification: Forty-five minutes covers the move, re-exports, type check and the existing library search test.

risk.justification: Eight modules import normalizarBusqueda and several import eventoDeTexto, so a changed synonym order silently alters search and event detection.

coupling.justification: Every later task consumes the extracted event vocabulary, making its export names a shared contract.

confidence.justification: All consumers were found by search and both functions were read in full; no product decision is involved.

acceptance_criteria: normalizarBusqueda lives in src/lib/texto/normalizar-busqueda.ts and biblioteca.ts re-exports it unchanged.
eventos-conocidos.ts exports EVENTOS_CONOCIDOS as a const tuple, an EventoCanonico union, eventoDeTexto and eventoDeMensajes, importing only the normalizer.
ideas-guiadas.ts re-exports eventoDeTexto and eventoDeMensajes so respuesta-guiada, pedido-ideas, hechos-cliente and route keep their imports.
Canonical names, synonyms and their order are byte-identical to the current list.

verification.purpose: type-checks every consumer of the re-exported functions
existing library-search regression after moving the normalizer

tasks.title: Add the curated activity-to-structure policy module
tasks.objective: A single client-safe module owns the ordered recommended structures per canonical activity and the resolver of the current turn's activity.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Small pure module and test; content depends on an unanswered owner table, which may cause rework.

complexity.justification: The table is simple, but a typed EventoCanonico union and a resolver shared by client and server need design choices.

scope.justification: One new pure module and one new test file, leaving existing behaviour untouched.

evidence: assumption:table from the prior REQ-017 plan with arco replacing arco_asimetrico
duration.justification: Sixty minutes for the typed table, resolver, invariant test and the import-safety assertion.

evidence: assumption:round-01 q1 has no owner answer
risk.justification: A wrong list shows unsuitable structures to every customer of that activity, and the table is unapproved owner policy.

coupling.justification: Server enforcement and the client menu both consume these signatures, so they form a shared contract.

evidence: assumption:owner may edit the mapping before implementation
confidence.justification: The code shape is clear, yet the table content and the arco substitution remain open owner questions.

acceptance_criteria: ESTRUCTURAS_POR_EVENTO is typed Readonly<Record<EventoCanonico, readonly EstructuraOficialId[]>> and holds the PLAN.md working table.
recomendadasParaEvento returns the ordered list for a canonical activity and null for an undefined or unrecognised one.
eventoCanonicoDelTurno canonicalises the brief event with eventoDeTexto first and falls back to eventoDeMensajes over customer messages.
The test asserts each list has at least three unique official IDs, none in ESTRUCTURAS_SIN_VISTA_3D, and that the module source imports no catalogue or server-only module.

verification.purpose: table invariants, resolver behaviour and client-safety import check

tasks.title: Add pure event-policy enforcement and schema narrowing
tasks.objective: A complete-composition proposal can be constrained and deterministically corrected to the allowed structures without touching protected customer-named pieces.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Pure logic with table-driven tests; replacement order is a planner assumption that may change.

complexity.justification: Replacement must respect tipoBase families, protected pieces, distinctness and medidas, mirroring propuestaConLoPedido without duplicating it.

scope.justification: A new pure enforcement module, one optional schema-helper parameter and a focused test file.

duration.justification: Seventy-five minutes covers the function, the parameter and cases for each SPEC edge case.

risk.justification: A faulty replacement could drop a requested piece or duplicate structures in proposals priced by the single quote engine.

coupling.justification: Consumes the T1.2 policy and defines the function that T2.2 wires into the shared route.

evidence: assumption:same-family replacement then first unused allowed structure
confidence.justification: Proposal flow and schema helper were read, but the replacement order rule is the planner's own assumption.

acceptance_criteria: esquemaHerramientaPropuesta accepts an optional allowed list and narrows the estructura enum only for completa without piezaPedida; without the list the output is unchanged.
ajustarPropuestaAlEvento keeps allowed or protected pieces and replaces others with an unused allowed structure of the same tipoBase, else the first unused allowed one.
Replacements keep cantidad, drop the replaced piece's medidas, never create duplicate structures and return one change line each.
The test covers narrowing, replacement, duplicates, protected pieces and the unknown-activity path without network or model calls.

verification.purpose: pure enforcement and schema narrowing cases

tasks.title: Apply the event policy in the guided-assistant route and audit it
tasks.objective: The server narrows and enforces the event policy on free complete proposals and records each active policy turn in the existing decision trail.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Insertion points are known, but the handler is long and its precedences must be preserved.

complexity.justification: The handler interleaves scope, customer facts, plan edits and organic-button rules, so the policy must slot in without reordering them.

scope.justification: Edits stay inside the alcance block, tool-schema construction and the proponer_composicion handler of one route.

duration.justification: Seventy-five minutes for wiring, the audit decision and source-level assertions in the existing test style.

risk.justification: The route serves every guided-chat customer in the beta, so a precedence mistake regresses live proposals until reverted.

coupling.justification: route.ts is a hotspot shared with other guided-chat requirements and depends on T2.1 helpers.

evidence: assumption:customer-named pieces exclude interface button texts
confidence.justification: Insertion points were read line by line, but protected-piece detection across history is an assumption.

acceptance_criteria: The policy is active only when alcancePropuesta is completa, planActual is absent and eventoCanonicoDelTurno resolves a recognised activity.
Customer-named structures from hechos.estructura and piezasNombradas over non-interface customer messages are protected and added to the narrowed enum.
The policy runs before propuestaConLoPedido inside proponer_composicion, so customer-named pieces keep precedence.
An active turn emits one regla:estructuras_por_evento decision with activity, allowed list, protected list and replacements; inactive turns emit none.
The test asserts the wiring order in route.ts source, as test-pulido-presentacion-guiada already does for other rules.

verification.purpose: route wiring, precedence and audit assertions
existing route source assertions for the organic button still hold

tasks.title: Build activity-aware piece menu options
tasks.objective: The piece menu can render the recommended official structures for a recognised activity, with the free-choice card last and today's menu for unknown activities.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Reuses the existing card component and exhaustive icons; label rules add a little reasoning.

complexity.justification: Card labels must avoid the known Arco orgánico collision while keeping the organic-button rule intact.

scope.justification: One exported pure helper and an optional prop in a single presentational component, plus its test.

duration.justification: Forty-five minutes because icons already cover every official ID and the card component is reused.

risk.justification: A label pointing at another structure would recreate the rejected arco_asimetrico behaviour for customers.

coupling.justification: Shares the policy contract with server enforcement and feeds T3.2, so the card shape must stay stable.

confidence.justification: Component and existing tests were read; the presentation choice of round-01 q5 is still unanswered.

acceptance_criteria: piezasDelMenu returns PIEZAS_INDIVIDUALES unchanged for an undefined or unrecognised activity.
For a recognised activity it returns one card per recommended ID in mapping order, each with that exact ID, then «La que tú quieras» with estructura null.
No event card reuses a generic-menu label for a different ID, and arco keeps the «Arco orgánico» label so piezaOrganicaDelBoton still applies.
PreguntaPropuesta accepts the card list as an optional prop that defaults to the generic list.

verification.purpose: card order, exact IDs, labels and unknown-activity fallback
existing «Arco orgánico» button guarantees still hold

tasks.title: Wire the activity menu into the guided view without changing saved widgets
tasks.objective: The live guided chat shows activity-specific piece cards while saved widget data and older deployments stay compatible.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Small edit in a very large component; state ownership must be read before changing the render site.

complexity.justification: VistaGuiada owns brief, messages and widget persistence in one large component, so state ownership must be respected.

scope.justification: A derived value, one prop at the widget render site and two analytics fields, with no schema edits.

duration.justification: Sixty minutes including reading the render path and running the type and contract checks.

risk.justification: Persisting a new widget field would break saved sessions under the strict schema on rollback.

coupling.justification: VistaGuiada is a hotspot for many guided-chat changes and consumes the T3.1 helper.

confidence.justification: Render and send paths were inspected, but no manual UI check is possible without paid model turns.

acceptance_criteria: VistaGuiada derives the activity at render time with eventoCanonicoDelTurno(brief.evento, customer message texts) and passes piezasDelMenu to the active piece widget.
WidgetGuiadoSchema, the saved-session shape and pregunta-propuesta widget fields are unchanged.
The existing propuesta.pieza action also records the resolved activity or null and the card's 1-based position.
Selecting an event card sends the existing piece text with alcance individual and the card's exact pieza ID.
VistaGuiada adds no import of ideas-guiadas.ts or biblioteca.ts.

verification.purpose: type-checks the new prop and derived value
request contract still accepts every official piezaPedida

tasks.title: Register new regressions in guiada:test and run the full gate
tasks.objective: The three new regression scripts run as part of guiada:test, and the repository gate result for the whole change is reported truthfully.
tasks.estimate_rationale: One script-line edit; time is dominated by the build and the existing test chain.

complexity.justification: Appending three test commands and running established project checks needs no design work.

scope.justification: Only the guiada:test script line in package.json changes.

duration.justification: Forty minutes is dominated by the Next.js build and the existing guided test chain.

risk.justification: A script-line edit is trivially reverted and cannot alter runtime behaviour.

coupling.justification: package.json is shared with other requirement branches, so this script line can conflict on merge.

confidence.justification: The commands exist in package.json, but their current baseline was not executed during planning.

acceptance_criteria: guiada:test also runs test-estructuras-por-evento.ts, test-propuesta-por-evento.ts and test-menu-pieza-por-evento.ts.
npm run lint, npm run build --workspaces --if-present, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run guiada:test and npm run build are run and each exit status is reported.
Any failure is classified as pre-existing or introduced, with the decisive error text.
No check makes a paid model or provider call.

verification.purpose: guided regression chain including the new scripts

verification.value: npm run lint && npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build
